Social legitimacy is mainstream, not community-native: SpaceX Jun-2026 Nasdaq IPO was the largest in US history ($75B raised at $135, now ~$160-167, ~$1.77T valuation); Robinhood's platform buckled under record retail traffic on listing day (4k outage reports); Musk publicly engaged on retail IPO access with Vlad Tenev. On-chain: 108.7k wallets, $29.4M 24h volume, 30 pairs, deep SPCX/USDG V3 pool ~$2.6M, CoinGecko listed rank #1213 (148 watchlists). SPCX is the chain's canonical quote asset for stock-paired memecoins (30 paired pools, $13.2M/day through meme pairs, $SPACEHOOD largest). Whale long reported by MEXC ($22.3M on Hyperliquid synthetic SPCX). Deductions: the token has NO website/social registered (tokenized debt security, not equity); SEC Jan-2026 guidance flagged synthetic-exposure stock tokens; unavailable to US persons; brand-mimic clones on Base/pons/clanker dilute the ticker. B = strong mainstream legitimacy with structural caveats. NOTE: this is an established $10M equity-exposure product, not a fresh meme launch; Humming Hymn flagged real-money execution as paused per the standing rule — Snug should treat accordingly.
